notes: Data drawn from D-Link's official DGS-1510 Series Hardware Installation Guide (Release 1.40, Aug 2017) plus the current D-Link product page. The 2 SFP+ ports are "dual speed" (1000BASE/10GBASE, auto-negotiating) and double as physical stacking ports when not used as uplinks; graded eth-10g reflecting their max capability. The 2 SFP-only ports are 1000BASE (eth-1g). Console port is RJ-45 (not USB or DB9). Rear-panel AC receptacle is a standard IEC C14 inlet (internal power supply rated 100-240VAC 50/60Hz, 253W max, 2A max per rear silkscreen). No USB port exists on this model. 1U rack-mountable (440 x 210 x 44 mm), mounting brackets included in box.

ports.name: 1-24 (10/100/1000BASE-T PoE)
ports.note: 24x RJ45 copper ports, 802.3af/at PoE+, up to 30W/port, 193W total PoE budget

ports.name: 27-28 (SFP+)
ports.note: 2x dual-speed SFP+ slots (1000BASE/10GBASE); also usable as dedicated physical stacking ports

ports.name: Console
ports.note: RJ-45 serial console/management port (not a data-carrying network port, so no eth grade set)

ports.name: AC Line
ports.note: Rear-panel IEC C14 AC inlet; internal supply rated 100-240VAC 50/60Hz, 253W max, 2A max
